en: Black-and-white photograph showing the richly decorated interior of a historic church. The view is from the back of the nave looking toward the altar, with wooden pews in the foreground, a carved pulpit on the left, painted vaulted ceilings with elaborate floral and ornamental motifs, religious paintings on the walls, and a large crystal chandelier hanging in the center. At the bottom right, printed text in Swedish identifies the subject as the interior of Kungs Lena Church.
